lines.say: Stop trusting the first AI answer. Add this one line first.
Unless it searches the web, it doesn't look anything up.
It guesses the next word, like your phone keyboard.
A likely word isn't always true, so wrong answers sound sure.
The line: if you're not sure, say I'm not sure.
lines.show: The line: say I'm not sure.

lines.say: Now it flags what it can't back up.
lines.show: Now it flags what it can't back up.

lines.say: The catch: it still slips. Check anything important.
Send this to the friend who trusts AI blindly. Comment TRUTH for the prompt.
lines.show: Send this. Comment TRUTH for the prompt.
